findings.correction: Central policy + aliases + owner checks + AI quotas; unknown commands fail closed.
findings.remaining_risk: Owner credentials remain powerful; public read-only commands are intentionally allowed.

findings.correction: Owner-only diagnostics, redaction, no prefixes/lengths.

findings.title: Heuristic score presented as success probability

findings.title: Direct Roblox API calls bypass shared scheduler/circuit
findings.location: commands_sales.py:262,336,349,359,448,479; commands_supercomputer.py:1107; creative_pivot.py:210; desc_forge.py:273; recovery_brain.py:373,413,427,442,503,532; suggest.py:86; tag_generator.py:285,289,297; roblox_batch_client.py:110-162
findings.evidence: Read-only GET probes and authenticated sales POST/CSRF calls now use safe_roblox. GETs use the shared scheduler; POSTs use a bounded 20/min budget, Retry-After-aware shared circuit, CSRF header preservation, and no added retries. The batch client checks/trips the shared circuit before batches and on 429 while preserving its AIMD/token-bucket behavior. Eight failure-injection tests pass. Remaining direct POST/PROBE paths outside the targeted modules may exist.
findings.correction: Shared GET and POST wrappers plus batch circuit coordination added; remaining paths require further routing.
findings.remaining_risk: The shared circuit is not yet universal across every historic direct request path.

findings.title: main unprotected and auto-deploy without required CI
findings.evidence: GitHub branch API reports protected=true. Active ruleset 26727577 requires pull_request, offline-regression, phase2-postgres, prohibits deletion/non-fast-forward, and has zero required approving reviews. No bypass actors are configured per the owner/API state. The audit claim of unprotected main was stale. sales-integrity is the unique former offline-regression job name.
findings.correction: No ruleset change made. Documentation corrected; remaining governance gap is zero approving reviews and no independently verified manual deployment approval.
findings.remaining_risk: PR+CI are required, but zero approvals and no manual deployment approval remain a release-governance gap.

findings.title: tracked_creators keyed only by numeric creator_id
findings.evidence: PRIMARY KEY (creator_id), creator_type default 'User'; ON CONFLICT (creator_id) DO NOTHING.
findings.correction: Requires reviewed composite-identity migration; not executed.
findings.remaining_risk: User/Group numeric-ID collisions can misattribute types.

findings.title: Creator Brain cohorts/patterns use display names

findings.correction: Requires stable-identity cohort migration and backfill plan; not executed.
findings.remaining_risk: Name collisions merge creators; renames split them.

findings.correction: Requires per-creator isolation/resumable discovery within existing budget; not executed.

findings.correction: Requires timestamp-standardization migration/plan; not executed.

findings.evidence: database.MY_SALES_DEDUPE_SQL now requires identical source_event_id. Disposable PostgreSQL test verifies two distinct event IDs with identical fingerprint both survive, while duplicate event IDs collapse to one. PG suite: 24/24.
